## Nothing Phone 3a Summary

Nothing Phone 3a is available at ₹24,999 in the 8 GB RAM + 128 GB storage configuration and was launched on March 11, 2025. Other configurations include 8 GB RAM + 256 GB storage at ₹29,999. It runs on Android v15 with Nothing OS and will receive 3 years of OS updates and 6 years of security updates. On the performance front, Nothing Phone 3a is powered by the Qualcomm Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 SM7635 chipset with Adreno 810 graphics and LPDDR4X RAM. In performance testing, Nothing Phone 3a records an AnTuTu score of 798,022, a Geekbench single-core score of 1,179 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 3,311. Its Wild Life Extreme score is 1,033, while its Steel Nomad score is 387. On the display front, Nothing Phone 3a gets a 6.77-inch Flexible AMOLED display with 1080x2392 px (FHD+) resolution, a 120 Hz refresh rate and 3000 nits peak brightness. The display also is protected by Panda Glass. In terms of design, Nothing Phone 3a measures 163.52 mm × 77.5 mm × 8.35 mm (H x W x T) and weighs 201 grams. It also has an IP64 rating for water and dust resistance. On the battery front, Nothing Phone 3a packs a 5000 mAh battery with Li-ion battery technology and supports 50W Fast Charging. In battery testing, Nothing Phone 3a records a PCMark battery life score of 14h 0m and takes 51m 50s to charge from 20% to 100%. After 30 minutes of gaming, the battery drain is 7%, while the recorded heating is 26%. For storage, Nothing Phone 3a comes with 128 GB / 256 GB of internal storage based on UFS 2.2 storage. It supports Dual SIM with SIM 1: Nano and SIM 2: Nano and is compatible with 5G and 4G networks. For connectivity, Nothing Phone 3a supports Wi-Fi 6 (802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax) 5GHz, MIMO, along with Bluetooth v5.4, GPS with A-GPS and Glonass and NFC. On the audio front, it features stereo speakers and includes a USB Type-C audio jack. A fingerprint sensor provides biometric security. For photography, Nothing Phone 3a features a triple rear camera setup with a 50 MP wide angle primary camera, an 8 MP ultra-wide angle secondary camera, and a 50 MP telephoto tertiary camera. The setup supports OIS and autofocus with phase detection autofocus. For video recording, the rear cameras support up to 4K @30 fps and Full HD @120 fps. The tertiary camera supports up to 30x digital zoom and up to 2x optical zoom. For selfies and video calls, Nothing Phone 3a features a single front camera with a 32 MP primary camera with a wide angle lens. For video recording, the front camera supports up to Full HD @60 fps.
